findings.message: Undefined legacy W'' remains in f''; the intended term is (w^eps)''. The estimator dependency chain cannot be certified as written until this notation omission is fixed.
X_k(tau) abbreviates episode-terminal wealth while X_u is calendar-indexed wealth and X_1 is the global initial value. The alias is explicitly defined but should be made less ambiguous.
Inherited daily/episode reference shorthand lacks explicit r_k := r_{t_k} and consecutive-episode t_{k+1}=t_k+h convention. Declare these relations or use distinct episode-local reference indices.
